    WALANG PASOK: Class Suspensions and Special Non-Working Holidays Announced for Monday, October 12, 2026

    Guro Tayo October 11, 2026 0
    October 11, 2026 — Several local government units (LGUs) and Malacañang have announced class suspensions and special non-working holidays for Monday, October 12, 2026, in selected areas across the Philippines.

    The announcements were made in connection with local festivals, religious celebrations, and a scheduled water supply interruption affecting parts of Bulacan.

    While some areas have declared a one-day special non-working holiday, the City of San Jose del Monte in Bulacan has announced a three-day suspension of classes in both public and private schools.

    Areas with Class Suspensions and Special Non-Working Holidays

    Based on the official proclamations, executive orders, and local government announcements, the following areas are covered:

    1. San Jose del Monte City, Bulacan — October 12–14, 2026

    The City Government of San Jose del Monte has announced the suspension of classes at all levels in both public and private schools from Monday, October 12, to Wednesday, October 14, 2026.

    Work in government offices will also be suspended during the same period.

    The suspension is due to the scheduled maintenance and shutdown of facilities operated by the Metropolitan Waterworks and Sewerage System (MWSS), which is expected to cause widespread water interruptions in Bulacan.

    The decision follows the recommendation of the Local Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (LDRRMC) through Resolution No. 2026-009.

    However, government offices responsible for basic and health services, disaster preparedness and response, and other essential services will continue operating.

    2. Pamplona, Negros Oriental — October 12, 2026

    President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr., through Proclamation No. 1476, declared Monday, October 12, 2026, a special non-working day in the Municipality of Pamplona, Negros Oriental.

    The declaration is in celebration of the Kasulad Festival, allowing residents to participate in the municipality's annual festivities.

    The special holiday applies specifically to the Municipality of Pamplona and not to the entire province of Negros Oriental.

    3. Talisay, Batangas — October 12, 2026

    Under Proclamation No. 1466, Malacañang declared October 12, 2026, a special non-working day in the Municipality of Talisay, Batangas.

    The declaration recognizes the municipality's commemoration of the Battle of Batangas.

    The proclamation aims to provide residents an opportunity to participate in activities marking the occasion.

    4. Pilar, Sorsogon — October 12, 2026

    The Municipality of Pilar, Sorsogon, will also observe a special non-working day on Monday, October 12, pursuant to Proclamation No. 1477.

    The holiday commemorates the Parau Festival, one of the municipality's local celebrations.

    The proclamation allows residents to participate in the festivities and other activities organized for the occasion.

    5. Mamburao, Occidental Mindoro — October 12, 2026

    The Municipal Government of Mamburao issued Executive Order No. 60, Series of 2026, suspending work in government offices and classes at all levels in both public and private schools on Monday, October 12.

    The suspension is in celebration of the annual feast of Nuestra Señora del Pilar Shrine and Parish.

    The local government issued the order in recognition of the religious celebration and to provide the community an opportunity to participate in the festivities.

    6. Cauayan City, Isabela — October 12, 2026

    The City Government of Cauayan issued Executive Order No. 92, Series of 2026, declaring Monday, October 12, a special non-working holiday in all government offices in the city.

    The declaration commemorates the Feast of Our Lady of the Pillar, the patron saint of Cauayan City.

    The holiday is intended to allow government personnel to participate in the city's religious and cultural celebration.

    However, the executive order provided specifically declares a holiday for government offices and does not expressly announce the suspension of classes in all schools. Students, parents, and teachers should await confirmation from their respective schools or education authorities.

    Important Reminder: Suspensions Are Not Nationwide

    The announced class suspensions and special non-working holidays apply only to the localities covered by the respective proclamations and executive orders.

    October 12, 2026, has not been declared a nationwide special non-working holiday under these announcements.

    Parents, learners, teachers, and school administrators are therefore advised to check the specific orders applicable to their respective localities.

    For areas observing special non-working holidays, schools should follow the applicable holiday regulations and any additional instructions issued by their school divisions or local education authorities.

    Stay Updated on Official Announcements

    Additional local government units may issue separate advisories depending on local circumstances.

    The public is encouraged to monitor announcements from their respective LGUs, the Department of Education (DepEd), and other authorized government offices for possible updates.

    This report is based on the official proclamations, executive orders, and local government advisories available as of October 11, 2026. The list will be updated as additional verified announcements become available.
